# Set-up

### Set WD for knitr
```{r setup, include=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
require("knitr")
opts_knit$set(root.dir = "~/How Hwee/PhD Stuff/Research/Self-Punishment/Data Package/Study 2/")
```

### Load packages
```{r message=F}
library(psych)
library(ggplot2)
library(effsize)
library(tidyr)
library(emmeans)
library(car)
library(ggpubr)
library(WRS2)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(ARTool)
```

### Read data file
```{r}
# Read CSV
df <- read.csv("Data Files/Study 2 - Raw Data - Deidentified.csv", skip=1, header=T)
df2 <- read.csv("Data Files/Study 2 - Raw Data - Deidentified.csv")
names(df) <- names(df2)
df <- df[-1,]

# Create Subject ID
df$ID <- as.factor(1:nrow(df))
```

BRET
(Compute the number of boxes opened)
```{r}
df$BRET1.opened <- count.fields(textConnection(df$Round1Opened), sep=",", blank.lines.skip = F)
df$BRET2.opened <- count.fields(textConnection(df$Round2Opened), sep=",", blank.lines.skip = F)
df$BRET.diff <- df$BRET2.opened - df$BRET1.opened
```

# Data Exclusion

To exclude participants who incorrectly recalled their version choice.
```{r}
df$Recall_Correct <- as.character(df$Game_Choice) == as.character(df$Recall)

#Frequency table
table(df$Recall_Correct)

#Drop cases who failed comprehension checks
df <- df[df$Recall_Correct == 1,]

```

# Data Preparation

### Demographics
```{r}
df$Gender <- factor(df$Gender, levels=c("1", "2", "3", "4"), labels=c("Male", "Female", "Other", "Prefer not to answer"))
table(df$Gender)

df$Age <- factor(df$Age, levels=c("1", "2"), labels=c("Yes","Prefer not to answer"))
table(df$Age)
df$Age.values <- as.numeric(as.character(df$Age_1_TEXT))
psych::describe(df$Age.values)
```

### Version Choice
```{r}
# Recode such that 0 = No pain (Version A), 1 = Pain (Version B)
df$Game_Choice_Binary <- NA
df$Game_Choice_Binary[df$Game_Choice == 1] <- 0
df$Game_Choice_Binary[df$Game_Choice == 2] <- 1

df$Game_Choice_Binary <- as.factor(df$Game_Choice_Binary)

# Frequency Distribution Table 
table(df$Game_Choice_Binary)
```
### Group 
```{r}
df$Group <- NULL
df$Group[df$Condition == "NoChoice"] <- "Control"
df$Group[df$Game_Choice_Binary == 0] <- "NoPain"
df$Group[df$Game_Choice_Binary == 1] <- "Pain"

table(df$Group)

```


Pain
```{r}
# Compute 
df$Pain <- as.numeric(as.character(df$Pain))
table(df$Pain)

```

# BRET Risk
```{r}


corr.test(df$BRET1.opened, df$BRET2.opened)
corr.test(df$BRET1.opened[df$Group == "Control"], df$BRET2.opened[df$Group == "Control"])
corr.test(df$BRET1.opened[df$Group == "Pain"], df$BRET2.opened[df$Group == "Pain"])
corr.test(df$BRET1.opened[df$Group == "NoPain"], df$BRET2.opened[df$Group == "NoPain"])

df$BRET1.time <- as.numeric(as.character(df$BRET1_t_Page.Submit))
df$BRET2.time <- as.numeric(as.character(df$BRET2_t_Page.Submit))

describeBy(df$BRET1.opened, group = df$Group)
describeBy(df$BRET2.opened, group = df$Group)
describeBy(df$BRET.diff, group = df$Group)

t.test(df$BRET.diff[df$Group == "Pain" | df$Group == "NoPain"] ~ 
         df$Group[df$Group == "Pain" | df$Group == "NoPain"])

t.test(df$BRET.diff[df$Group == "Pain" | df$Group == "Control"] ~ 
         df$Group[df$Group == "Pain" | df$Group == "Control"])

t.test(df$BRET.diff[df$Group == "NoPain" | df$Group == "Control"] ~ 
         df$Group[df$Group == "NoPain" | df$Group == "Control"])

#one sample t-test against zero
t.test(df$BRET.diff[df$Group == "Pain"], mu = 0, alternative = "two.sided")
t.test(df$BRET.diff[df$Group == "NoPain"], mu = 0, alternative = "two.sided")
t.test(df$BRET.diff[df$Group == "Control"], mu = 0, alternative = "two.sided")
```
Difference Score Bar Graph
```{r}
# Bargraph
ggplot(df, aes(x=Group, y=BRET.diff, fill=Group)) +
  geom_bar(position="dodge", stat="summary", fun="mean") +
  stat_summary(fun.data=mean_se, fun.args = list(mult=1), 
        geom="errorbar", width=0.2, color="black") +
  labs(title= "Difference Score by Group", y = "Difference Score (BRET #2 - BRET #1)")

```

### Belief in Karma scale
```{r}
df$Karma_1 <- as.numeric(as.character(df$BK_1))
df$Karma_2 <- as.numeric(as.character(df$BK_2))
df$Karma_3 <- as.numeric(as.character(df$BK_3))
df$Karma_4 <- as.numeric(as.character(df$BK_4))
df$Karma_5 <- as.numeric(as.character(df$BK_5))
df$Karma_6 <- as.numeric(as.character(df$BK_6))
df$Karma_7 <- as.numeric(as.character(df$BK_7))
df$Karma_8 <- as.numeric(as.character(df$BK_8))
df$Karma_9 <- as.numeric(as.character(df$BK_9))
df$Karma_10 <- as.numeric(as.character(df$BK_10))
df$Karma_11 <- as.numeric(as.character(df$BK_11))
df$Karma_12 <- as.numeric(as.character(df$BK_12))
df$Karma_13 <- as.numeric(as.character(df$BK_13))
df$Karma_14 <- as.numeric(as.character(df$BK_14))
df$Karma_15 <- as.numeric(as.character(df$BK_15))
df$Karma_16 <- as.numeric(as.character(df$BK_16))

df$Karma_2r <- 6 - df$Karma_2
df$Karma_14r <- 6 - df$Karma_14

Karma_list <- cbind(df$Karma_1,
                    df$Karma_2r,
                    df$Karma_3,
                    df$Karma_4,
                    df$Karma_5,
                    df$Karma_6,
                    df$Karma_7,
                    df$Karma_8,
                    df$Karma_9,
                    df$Karma_10,
                    df$Karma_11,
                    df$Karma_12,
                    df$Karma_13,
                    df$Karma_14r,
                    df$Karma_15,
                    df$Karma_16)

df$Karma <- rowMeans(Karma_list)
df$Karma.ctr <- df$Karma - mean(df$Karma)

# Karma  by Group
describe(df$Karma)
describeBy(df$Karma, group = df$Group)

### Pain vs. No Pain
t.test(df$Karma[df$Group == "Pain" | df$Group == "NoPain"] ~ 
         df$Group[df$Group == "Pain" | df$Group == "NoPain"])

### Pain vs. Control
t.test(df$Karma[df$Group == "Pain" | df$Group == "Control"] ~ 
         df$Group[df$Group == "Pain" | df$Group == "Control"])

### NoPain vs. Control
t.test(df$Karma[df$Group == "NoPain" | df$Group == "Control"] ~ 
         df$Group[df$Group == "NoPain" | df$Group == "Control"])


# Alpha for Belief in Karma
psych::alpha(Karma_list)

# Correlation: BRET.diff x BK
corr.test(df$BRET.diff, df$Karma)
cor.test(df$BRET.diff[df$Group == "Pain"], df$Karma[df$Group == "Pain"])
cor.test(df$BRET.diff[df$Group == "NoPain"], df$Karma[df$Group == "NoPain"])
cor.test(df$BRET.diff[df$Group == "Control"], df$Karma[df$Group == "Control"])

corr.karma.pain <- cor(df$BRET.diff[df$Group == "Pain"], df$Karma[df$Group == "Pain"])
corr.karma.nopain <- cor(df$BRET.diff[df$Group == "NoPain"], df$Karma[df$Group == "NoPain"])
corr.karma.control <- cor(df$BRET.diff[df$Group == "Control"], df$Karma[df$Group == "Control"])
n.pain <- nrow(df[df$Group == "Pain",])
n.nopain <- nrow(df[df$Group == "NoPain",])
n.control <- nrow(df[df$Group == "Control",])

# Pain vs. NoPain
r.test(n = n.pain, 
       n2 = n.nopain,
       r12 = corr.karma.pain, 
       r34 = corr.karma.nopain)

# Pain vs. Control
r.test(n = n.pain, 
       n2 = n.control,
       r12 = corr.karma.pain, 
       r34 = corr.karma.control)

# NoPain vs. Control
r.test(n = n.nopain, 
       n2 = n.control,
       r12 = corr.karma.nopain, 
       r34 = corr.karma.control)

```

# Wide to Long Conversion (for mixed ANOVA)
'df.long' is the 'long' dataframe
```{r}
df.long <- gather(df, time, BRET, c("BRET1.opened", "BRET2.opened"))

df.long <- df %>% 
  pivot_longer(c("BRET1.opened", "BRET2.opened"), names_to = "time", values_to = "BRET")

```

# BRET Scores
# Mixed ANOVA: BRET x Pain vs. No Pain (Model 1a)
```{r}
ANOVA.Model1a <- aov(BRET ~ Group*time + Error(ID/time), 
                       data=df.long[(df.long$Group == "Pain" | df.long$Group == "NoPain"),])
summary(ANOVA.Model1a)


model.tables(ANOVA.Model1a, "means")

ANOVA.Model1a.decompose<-emmeans(ANOVA.Model1a, ~time|as.factor(Group))
ANOVA.Model1a.decompose
pairs(ANOVA.Model1a.decompose)

## to check results using lmer instead of anova approach. Some minor varations for main effects, but interaction effect is the same. This is likely because aov uses type I SS, while lmer uses type III ss. 

lmer.Model1a <- lmer(BRET ~ Group*time + (1|ID), 
                     data=df.long[(df.long$Group == "Pain" | df.long$Group == "NoPain"),])
summary(lmer.Model1a)

```

# Mixed ANOVA: BRET x Pain vs. Control (Model 1b)
```{r}
ANOVA.Model1b <- aov(BRET ~ Group*time + Error(ID/time), 
                       data=df.long[(df.long$Group == "Pain" | df.long$Group == "Control"),])
summary(ANOVA.Model1b)

model.tables(ANOVA.Model1b, "means")

ANOVA.Model1b.decompose<-emmeans(ANOVA.Model1b, ~time|as.factor(Group))
ANOVA.Model1b.decompose
pairs(ANOVA.Model1b.decompose)

lmer.Model1b <- lmer(BRET ~ Group*time + (1|ID), 
                     data=df.long[(df.long$Group == "Pain" | df.long$Group == "Control"),])
summary(lmer.Model1b)
```

# Karma as moderator (BRET ~ Group * Time * Karma)
(Model 3)

```{r}
# Pain vs. No Pain
lmer.Model3a <- lmer(BRET ~ Group*time*Karma.ctr + (1|ID), 
                       data=df.long[(df.long$Group == "Pain" | df.long$Group == "NoPain"),])
summary(lmer.Model3a)

# Pain vs. Control
lmer.Model3b <- lmer(BRET ~ Group*time*Karma.ctr + (1|ID), 
                       data=df.long[(df.long$Group == "Pain" | df.long$Group == "Control"),])
summary(lmer.Model3b)

# No pain vs. Control
lmer.Model3c <- lmer(BRET ~ Group*time*Karma.ctr + (1|ID),
                       data=df.long[(df.long$Group == "NoPain" | df.long$Group == "Control"),])
summary(lmer.Model3c)
```
